preconditions.description: The number of test cases is between 1 and 50,000.
The number of vertices in each test case is between 1 and 500,000.
The vertices connected by each edge are within the range of vertex indices.

preconditions.expression: There is at least one uncolored vertex.
preconditions.description: Each test case contains at least one uncolored vertex.

preconditions.expression: There is no path of three white vertices.
preconditions.description: No three vertices are connected to form a path of three vertices in white.

preconditions.expression: The sum of all n among all test cases is at most 500000.
preconditions.description: The total number of vertices across all test cases is at most 500,000.

postconditions.description: The output for each test case is one of the three possible outcomes.
